_about: The words the hacks put on screen through Red's call-out line (the sandbox HUD shows them; the slice HUD has its own hack panel). {name} is the hack's name, {cost} what it costs, {have} what the battery holds, {left} what is left after a cast. Owner: Combat Designer for the wording, Combat Programmer for the keys. An empty line is never shown (so a mashed button says nothing while a cast is already on its way).
